name: New line - $200 off per line when ordering online
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-25. Customer voice: deal hunter.
scripted_messages: Hi! I'm trying to understand the online-only $200 off per line deal. I want to add two new lines on Premium 2.0 with the iPhone 17 Pro at $9.99 a month each. How does the $200 get applied, and what would my monthly total be for both lines?
Thanks. Is the $200 a bill credit over the 36 months?
And do I need to order online for it to count?
What would the first bill look like with fees and taxes for both lines?
Okay, that's more than I figured for month one, but you explained everything really well. Thank you for being so friendly.
That's all. Have a great day, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the previous question
before message 6: agent: answers the follow-up (a bill question usually gets 'please allow me a moment to calculate')
before message 7: agent: waiting message while calculating the bill
before message 8: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 9: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
